name: Title with three footage tiles
what: A title is typed small out of a blur, grows with a soft glow and holds; then three tilted footage tiles slide in one after another (from the left, the bottom and the right) and cover most of it, and the scene floats a few pixels to the end.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f12-f53 the title is typed letter by letter out of a blur, small; f45-f56 it grows about its bottom-left corner to 2.7 x with a glow (accelerating); f56-f92 it holds, drifting a hair; f93-f140 the left tile slides in from the left edge (decelerating); f112-f150 the middle tile rises from the bottom edge; f120-f160 the right tile slides in from the right edge; f140-f300 the scene floats a few pixels
